messages:
Sara Patel: Heads-up — hotfix cut in ~45m (12:30 UTC). PR #9407 needs 2x LGTM before cutoff. It's the config+migration tweak that fixes shard assignment for dedicated pools. If we don't have two approvals by cutoff we'll have to delay the roll.
Mike Chen: Link?
Sara Patel: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/9407 — looks small, two files: config change + migration. I left a brief description in the PR about rollback steps.
Anjali Rao: I left a review with one nits comment on naming, otherwise LGTM from me once CI is green :+1:
Oliver Grant: Can do second LGTM but want to run smoke on staging first. Will kick off the staging job now and report back.
Kevin Lopez: I'm still reproducing the issue locally, might be blocked by a provider quota on my side. If Oliver's smoke passes I can sign off after I confirm the migration won't lose KV cache keys.
CI Bot: build 9407-preview • tests: unit ✅ integration ❌ (flaky failure in kv-store-test). Rerunning in 2m.
Mike Chen: @Oliver Grant any ETA on smoke? If we get a green smoke in 10m that's tight but doable.
Oliver Grant: Started smoke at 1768894500, infra lookups passed. Running a quick load ramp (5m). If no regressions, I'll post results and LGTM.
Sara Patel: If CI keeps flaking we can fallback to manual verification steps I posted in the PR. There's a short checklist under 'Testing notes'.
Anjali Rao: Note: the naming nit is cosmetic; doesn't affect behavior. I'm comfortable with the fix itself.
CI Bot: re-run 9407-preview • integration ✅ unit ✅ — all tests green.
Oliver Grant: Smoke passed on staging. Load + correctness checks look good. Posted notes in PR — I can give LGTM now.
Kevin Lopez: Gave a quick DB-level check against migration script, keys preserved on my repro. LGTM from me as well.
Mike Chen: Two LGTM, CI green. Ready to merge on my mark. Sara, you want to cut at 12:30 UTC or wait 5m for any late asks?
Sara Patel: Merge on your mark. I'll monitor deploy and be ready to rollback if anything weird in the first 10m.
Mike Chen: Merging in 30s. `gh pr merge 9407 --squash` :hammer_and_wrench:
Sara Patel: :rocket: Deploy started. I'll update here with the deploy link and smoke results.
CI Bot: deploy job 9407-prod • started
Oliver Grant: I'll do the first 2m of smoke post-deploy and call out any immediate regressions.
Sara Patel: All good on my end so far. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround. :tada:
Kevin Lopez: Thanks — will follow up on the ticket with a couple of post-deploy checks.
Mike Chen: Closing thread after 10m if stable. Great job team.
